name: Tim Lashomb
public_footprint:
Timothy Lashomb, of Ogdensburg, NY, earned SUNY Canton Dean's List honors in multiple semesters from 2019 to 2022 and President's List honors in spring 2022 while enrolled in the Mechanical Engineering Technology program.
Sources: https://canton.meritpages.com/stories/Timothy-Lashomb-is-on-the-SUNY-Canton-Dean-s-List-/14642379; https://canton.meritpages.com/stories/Timothy-Lashomb-Earns-President-s-List-Honors-at-SUNY-Canton/84827762
